name: C11/C++11 Memory Model
description: The first standardised memory model for C and C++. Introduces a hierarchy of atomic operations (relaxed, acquire, release, acq_rel, seq_cst) and defines data-race-free (DRF) programs. Formally specified by Batty et al. Contains the notorious 'thin-air' problem for relaxed atomics.

catSupport.note: herd7 ships c11_orig.cat with the c11.bell event/label declarations; the zoo also runs the vendored litmus/models/cpp/cpp11.cat.

katSupport.note: kater's kat/c11-old.kat is the original C11 model of Batty et al. — the same node this row names.
